# Table Space: The Ultimate Mixed-Reality Tabletop Games Sandbox

Welcome to Table Space, a new sandbox where your favorite tabletop games come to life! Play classic games like Texas Hold'em Poker, Hanafuda, Tarot, Trading Card Games, or any card game imaginable with friends in a fully immersive environment.

Customize your gaming space with various themes and settings to create the perfect atmosphere. Connect with friends through integrated voice chat, join public lobbies, and personalize your experience. With a growing library of game modes and regular updates, there's always something new to discover.

### Features:
- **Versatile Gameplay:** Enjoy a wide range of games including Texas Hold'em Poker, Tarot, Trading Card Games, Hanafuda, and more to come.
- **Customizable Environments:** Tailor your gaming space with various themes and settings.
- **Social Integration:** Connect with friends, join public lobbies, and enjoy seamless voice chat.
- **Constant Updates:** Benefit from regular updates and new game modes.
- **Mixed-Reality Innovation:** Interact with the game using your hands just like in a real-life card game, enhanced by our custom-designed interactions for an even better experience.

Join the Table Space community and redefine your tabletop gaming experience. Every game is a new adventure in this vibrant and ever-evolving platform. Discover the future of tabletop gaming with Table Space!

changelog.change_log:
Introducing the new Main Store menu in the Lobby where you can get all the premium content like "Tiny Me"s, Avatar Styles, and Game Modes.


This update also brings onboarding tutorial videos to help you navigate Table Space.
Happy new year! Celebrate with us with stylish 2025-shaped glasses. Get them for free when you leave a review for Table Space.
A train arrived from the North Pole to Table Space, it brought flippable coins, and dreidels to make your tabletop games more fun!

Let it snow! Introducing a new festive snowman avatar and beautiful snowy particle effect in the lobby so you can enjoy the winter holiday season with friends. Cozy up and play tabletop games together in Table Space. �
Let it snow! This update brings a delightful new winter-themed lobby for you to explore. Cozy up with some hot cocoa and enjoy tabletop games with friends, happy holidays!

Bugfixes, UX enhancements, and performance improvements to the new trading card game mode life counters and discard pile interactions.

New navigation arrow and recentering indicators to help you find the game table if you lose track of it or the initial saved position is far from your current location.

This release is focused on improving the experience of playing Trading Card Games in Table Space. We've added:

- Added new sphere counters with +1, -1, +10, -10 options.

- Added a discard pile.

This update to Table Space brings usability and multiplayer quality of life improvements!


We added a new table locking interaction to avoid accidentally moving the table while you're playing.

We now support destinations and invites on Quest, so you can easily launch into multiplayer rooms with your friends!
Added support for Tarot cards as a new premium game mode!

Added new Skeleton tiny avatar to the public lobby to celebrate Halloween!


Now you can use voice chat in public lobby, also mute yourself and control the general voice chat volume.

Fixed recentering issues.

Fixed poker chips stacks showing wrong number of chips.

Easter on October!?

Happy Halloween Month!


The latest release of Table Space introduces a brand new festive public lobby for joining popular game rooms and meeting other online players.


We remember your most recently joined rooms for easy access and display online counts for rooms before joining.

Dramatically improved card legibility in Trading Card Game Mode with a new index finger laser pointer interaction. Just point at a card from any distance for a close-up zoomed-in overlay! 

Bugfixes, polish, and refinements to the menu UI system with new 3D table menu UI buttons.

Patch release. 
 Fixes to untap all. 
 Improved performance on texture loading for trading card game mode.

- Adds a slider that dims the table visibility. No more drink spills!

- Added red, blue, and black chip colors with varying values.

- Added Auto-dealing and auto-cleanup from a new radial menu on the deck.

- Added Free Mode, you can now play any game you want with a standard deck of cards.
